nodes.label: AdMob Mediation (Next-Gen)
nodes.rationale: Host apps add Maven com.google.ads.mediation:* adapters and exclude legacy play-services-ads; do not use gma_mediation_* or google_mobile_ads.

nodes.label: AgeRestrictedTreatment
nodes.rationale: Replaces deprecated TagForChildDirectedTreatment / TagForUnderAgeOfConsent; matches GMA Next-Gen setAgeRestrictedTreatment.

nodes.label: NativeCustomAdView
nodes.rationale: Custom templates inflate programmatically from asset XML (not LayoutInflater on XmlPullParser) to avoid XmlPullAttributes cast crash; supports Android Space widgets.

nodes.label: PictureInPictureAd
nodes.rationale: Added in 0.1.4 for GMA Next-Gen 1.4.0 open beta: floating draggable ad with load/show/hide/dispose that is not consumed when hidden.

nodes.label: ads-mobile-sdk bump process
nodes.rationale: Next-Gen SDK APIs change between versions; bump requires reading release notes, updating android/build.gradle.kts, re-verifying Kotlin call sites, and physical-device example runs.

nodes.label: admob_flutter_plus example app
nodes.rationale: Mounts one section at a time (not TabBarView) so PlatformViews dispose cleanly between formats.

nodes.label: pub.dev publish workflow
nodes.rationale: Do not publish until dry-run reports 0 warnings (or only accepted ones); prefer a new patch over dart pub unpublish.

nodes.label: Ad preloaders (interstitial/rewarded/RI)
nodes.rationale: SDK ships preloaders for more formats, but Google guides document preloading for interstitial, rewarded, and rewarded interstitial only; plugin exposes those three; bufferSize 1–15.

nodes.label: admob_flutter_plus
nodes.rationale: Unofficial community Flutter plugin wrapping Google Mobile Ads Next-Gen SDK on Android; not published or endorsed by Google.

nodes.label: AppOpenAd
nodes.rationale: Drive presentation from process lifecycle via AppStateEventNotifier, not WidgetsBindingObserver, so showing another full-screen ad is not mistaken for backgrounding; expires four hours after load.

nodes.label: BannerAdView
nodes.rationale: Needs bounded height; AdSize.anchored maps to getLargeAnchoredAdaptiveBannerAdSize per Next-Gen docs, not the deprecated current-orientation API.

nodes.label: google_mobile_ads
nodes.rationale: Legacy Play Services Ads Flutter package; conflicts with Next-Gen — do not use alongside this plugin or gma_mediation_* packages.

nodes.label: iOS roadmap
nodes.rationale: iOS not implemented in v1; adding ios/ behind the same Dart API is tracked as future work.

nodes.label: PictureInPictureAd
nodes.rationale: Prefer when a full-screen interstitial would interrupt the session; snaps to corner, not consumed on hide; no PiP preloader in Next-Gen SDK.

nodes.label: UMP ConsentInformation / ConsentForm
nodes.rationale: Always wrap consent in try/catch so an offline consent failure never blocks startup; must always reach runApp().

nodes.label: Modular format isolation
nodes.rationale: Each ad format has one Dart module and one Kotlin manager; no cross-imports between format managers except through shared core/.

nodes.label: Versioning policy
nodes.rationale: MAJOR for breaking Dart API or min SDK with breaking native change; MINOR for new format/params/template; PATCH for bugs, docs, native SDK patch bumps.

nodes.label: Android-only platform support
nodes.rationale: v1 is Android-only; Dart API is platform-agnostic so iOS can be added later without breaking changes; non-Android uses placeholders/no-ops.

nodes.label: Future-first Dart API
nodes.rationale: await load returns the ad or throws AdLoadException instead of onAdLoaded/onAdFailedToLoad load listeners used by google_mobile_ads.
